name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: Copy the Keychron K4 website’s dark grey background for the Mine AI site. It signals tech credibility without screaming "gadget ad," which keeps the focus on the AI product’s substance. The trade-off is losing the playful punch of bright colors, but that’s a cost worth paying to avoid looking like a toy.

name: Squint
text: The risk isn’t just losing playful punch—it’s signaling stodgy corporate tech, not cutting-edge AI. A better alternative is a deep charcoal with subtle gradient, like Eitan’s Beverage Cans site but muted, to keep tech credibility without the flat grey’s dullness. Settle it by mocking both options side-by-side with real AI product screenshots—if the charcoal gradient doesn’t outperform the flat grey in user tests, scrap it.
